migrations.title: Update zod imports
migrations.description: Replace `import { z } from 'zod'` with `import { z } from 'astro/zod'` in all files.

migrations.title: Update Zod 4 API calls
migrations.description: Replace `z.string().email()` with `z.email()` and `.errors` with `.issues` on ZodError.

migrations.title: Remove experimental.contentIntellisense
migrations.description: Delete the `experimental: { contentIntellisense: true }` block from astro.config.mjs.

migrations.title: Configure astro:env
migrations.description: Add env schema to astro.config.mjs and update import.meta.env references to use astro:env imports.

migrations.title: Remove colorScheme prop from Button
migrations.description: The `colorScheme` prop has been removed from Button. Wrap the Button in a `<div class="invert-section">` instead.

migrations.title: Remove variant="invert" from Input
migrations.description: The `variant="invert"` prop has been removed from Input. Wrap the Input in a `<div class="invert-section">` instead.

migrations.title: Rename selectSize to size on Select
migrations.description: The `selectSize` prop on Select has been renamed to `size`. Update: `selectSize="sm"` → `size="sm"`.

migrations.title: Rename textareaSize to size on Textarea
migrations.description: The `textareaSize` prop on Textarea has been renamed to `size`. Update: `textareaSize="sm"` → `size="sm"`.

migrations.title: Migrate routes.ts to nav.config.ts
migrations.description: Replace `src/config/routes.ts` with `src/config/nav.config.ts`. Delete routes.ts and update imports.

migrations.title: Verify image rendering after Astro 6 beta.20 upgrade
migrations.description: Astro 6 changed image defaults: cropping is now enabled by default and images are never upscaled. Visually verify hero images, blog post images, and OG images render correctly. If images appear cropped unexpectedly, add `fit: 'contain'` to your Image components.

migrations.title: Check heading anchor links in MDX content
migrations.description: Astro 6 changed the heading ID generation algorithm. If you have internal links to heading anchors (e.g., `#my-heading`), verify they still resolve correctly after the upgrade.

migrations.title: Review script and style ordering
migrations.description: Astro 6 now renders `<script>` and `<style>` tags in definition order instead of grouping them. If you have custom components with scripts that depend on specific load ordering, verify they still work correctly.

migrations.title: Upgrade Vitest to v3.2+
migrations.description: Astro 6 bundles Vite 7, which requires Vitest 3.2+. The dependency update handles the version bump, but if you have a vitest.config.ts or custom Vitest configuration, review the Vitest 3 migration guide: https://vitest.dev/guide/migration.html

migrations.title: Verify @astrojs/check stable compatibility
migrations.description: The @astrojs/check package has been upgraded from 0.9.7-beta.1 to 0.9.7 stable. Run `pnpm check` to verify your project passes type checking with the stable release.

migrations.title: Confirm all beta packages are replaced with stable releases
migrations.description: All Astro packages have moved from beta to stable: astro 6.0.0, @astrojs/mdx 5.0.0, @astrojs/react 5.0.0. Run `pnpm install && pnpm build` to verify compatibility. No code changes should be needed — this is a dependency-only upgrade.

migrations.title: Restore --color-background-deep if used
migrations.description: The CSS variable `--color-background-deep` was removed from global.css, default.css, and midnight.css. If your components reference this token (e.g., Showcase, MarketingFooter), add it back to your theme files: `--color-background-deep: oklch(0.13 0.02 260);`

migrations.title: Restore heading font-size rules if needed
migrations.description: Base `h1`–`h6` font-size rules were removed from global.css. If your pages rely on these global heading sizes rather than Tailwind utility classes, add them back to your own stylesheet.

migrations.title: Header max-width changed from max-w-6xl to max-w-4xl
migrations.description: The floating header variant changed its max-width from `max-w-6xl` to `max-w-4xl`. If your layout depends on the wider header, override this in your Header component or layout.

migrations.title: Upgrade Node.js to 22.23.4 or later
migrations.description: Astro 7.4 requires Node.js >=22.23.4. Node 24 LTS is recommended (.nvmrc now pins 24). Update your local Node, CI, and hosting settings (e.g. NODE_VERSION on Netlify).

migrations.title: Keep HTML whitespace behavior (compressHTML)
migrations.description: Astro 7 defaults `compressHTML` to 'jsx', which removes whitespace between inline elements ("Docs Blog" renders as "DocsBlog"). Add `compressHTML: true` to astro.config.mjs to keep Astro 6 behavior, or audit your markup and add {' '} where spacing matters.

migrations.title: Register the Fonts API families in astro.config.mjs
migrations.description: BaseLayout now renders <Font cssVariable="--font-manrope" /> etc. and global.css no longer imports @fontsource-variable CSS. Copy the `fonts` array, `fontsourceVariable()` helper and LATIN/LATIN_EXT constants from the v2.0.0 astro.config.mjs, or the build fails with FontFamilyNotFound. Custom themes should reference var(--font-manrope) / var(--font-outfit) / var(--font-jetbrains-mono).

migrations.title: Add a server adapter (deploy target auto-detection)
migrations.description: Forms now use Astro Actions, which need a server runtime. Add `import { resolveDeployTarget } from './integrations/deploy-target.mjs'`, `const target = await resolveDeployTarget();`, `adapter: target.adapter`, and `cache: { provider: target.cacheProvider ?? memoryCache() }` to astro.config.mjs. Vercel/Netlify are detected automatically; set DEPLOY_TARGET to override. Cloudflare needs `pnpm add @astrojs/cloudflare`.

migrations.title: Move form handlers from /api routes to Astro Actions
migrations.description: src/pages/api/contact.ts and newsletter.ts were removed — they never ran on static builds. Copy src/actions/index.ts from v2.0.0 and port any custom logic (email/CRM calls) into the action handlers. Forms that posted to /api/contact or /api/newsletter should use <ContactForm /> / <NewsletterForm />, which call the actions.

migrations.title: Add Pagefind search
migrations.description: Add `import pagefind from './integrations/pagefind.mjs'` and `pagefind()` to integrations in astro.config.mjs, and copy src/pages/search.astro. Content is indexed only inside `data-pagefind-body` (PageLayout and BlogLayout set this).

migrations.title: Remove nested <main> elements
migrations.description: BaseLayout already renders <main id="main-content">. PageLayout previously nested a second <main>, which is invalid. If your own layouts or pages render <main>, change it to <div>.

migrations.title: Fix markup rejected by the Rust compiler
migrations.description:
Astro 7 replaces the Go compiler with a stricter Rust compiler: unclosed non-void tags now error and invalid nesting (e.g.
inside

) is no longer auto-corrected. Run `pnpm build` and fix any reported components.

migrations.title: Install @astrojs/markdown-remark if you use remark/rehype plugins
migrations.description: Astro 7's default Markdown processor is Sätteri. If astro.config.mjs uses markdown.remarkPlugins / rehypePlugins, run `pnpm add @astrojs/markdown-remark` and set `markdown: { processor: unified({ remarkPlugins: [...] }) }`.

migrations.title: Replace removed astro:transitions internals
migrations.description: TRANSITION_* constants, isTransitionBeforePreparationEvent(), isTransitionBeforeSwapEvent() and createAnimationScope() were removed. Use string event names such as 'astro:after-swap' and compare event.type directly.

migrations.title: Update getContainerRenderer imports
migrations.description: Import container renderers from the new entrypoint: `import { getContainerRenderer } from '@astrojs/react/container-renderer'`.

migrations.title: Opt out of sessions (optional)
migrations.description: Velocity sets `session: false` so adapters do not provision session storage. Remove it if you use Astro.session.

migrations.title: ClientRouter replaced by native view transitions
migrations.description: BaseLayout no longer renders <ClientRouter />. Navigation uses CSS `@view-transition { navigation: auto; }` (in global.css) and `prefetch: { prefetchAll: true, defaultStrategy: 'hover' }` in astro.config.mjs. Add the prefetch block to your config. Scripts that only listen for `astro:page-load` must also run on initial load: call init() directly and listen for `astro:after-swap`. If you use transition:persist, transition:name or navigate(), keep ClientRouter and set `security.csp: false`.

migrations.title: Content Security Policy enabled
migrations.description: astro.config.mjs now sets `security.csp` (hash-based script-src, Shiki-compatible style-src-attr). Copy the `csp` block into your config. Inline scripts that use `define:vars` or interpolate values at runtime cannot be hashed. Move dynamic data into `<script type="application/json">` elements (see Analytics.astro). Third-party script hosts need `Astro.csp.insertScriptResource()`. Run `pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e`, which fails on CSP violations.

migrations.title: Install new dev dependencies
migrations.description: Velocity 2.0 adds two devDependencies the CLI cannot add for you: run `pnpm add -D @typescript-eslint/parser@8.72.1 @axe-core/playwright@^4.14.0`. The first lets eslint-plugin-astro type-check <script> blocks under pnpm; the second powers the accessibility tests. Then copy tests/, vitest.config.ts and playwright.config.ts, and run `pnpm exec playwright install chromium`.

migrations.title: Use an accessible Shiki theme
migrations.description: Code-block comments in Shiki's `github-dark` theme fail WCAG AA contrast (3.0:1). Velocity 2.0 sets `markdown.shikiConfig.theme: 'github-dark-default'`. Update astro.config.mjs if you kept the old theme.

migrations.title: ESLint 10 and tailwind-merge 3
migrations.description: ESLint 10 adds no-useless-assignment and preserve-caught-error to the recommended set; fix any new findings in your own code. tailwind-merge 3 understands Tailwind v4 syntax (bg-(--var), duration-(--var), bg-linear-*), so cn() now resolves conflicts that v2 got wrong. If you relied on the old (incorrect) merge results, re-check custom class overrides.

migrations.title: Built-in i18n: locale config and translations
migrations.description: Velocity 2 is locale-aware in core. Add src/i18n/locales.mjs (export const defaultLocale = 'en'; export const locales = ['en'];) and src/i18n/translations/en.ts (export default an object of your site copy), and add the i18n block to astro.config.mjs: i18n: { defaultLocale, locales: [...locales], routing: { prefixDefaultLocale: false } }. Projects created with the v1 --i18n flag: move src/i18n/translations/{es,fr}.ts content into the new format and list the locales in locales.mjs; delete src/i18n/routes.ts (routes now live in nav.config.ts).

migrations.title: nav.config.ts: routes, header and footer config
migrations.description: nav.config.ts now exports routes (with optional translated slugs), navItems (label + route or href), headerConfig (CTA, actions, extra nav) and footerConfig. Header/Footer read these defaults, so remove the hardcoded cta/actions/extraNav props from your layouts and pages. This file is now user-owned (protected) and upgrades no longer overwrite it: merge the new shape from the v2.0.0 template by hand.

migrations.title: Pages render views
migrations.description: Page content moved to src/views/*View.astro components that take a locale prop; src/pages/*.astro are thin wrappers and src/pages/[lang]/ holds the localized wrappers. Custom pages keep working as-is; to localize one, follow src/views/AboutView.astro + src/pages/[lang]/[...about].astro.

migrations.title: Blog URLs and OG images
migrations.description: Use the helpers in src/lib/blog.ts (getPosts, getPostUrl, getPostSlug) instead of building /blog/ URLs from post.id. OG images are now generated at /og/<page path>.png; blog posts previously pointed at images that did not exist (/og/blog/<slug>.png vs /og/blog/en/<slug>.png).

migrations.title: Form validation messages are translation keys
migrations.description: contactSchema/newsletterSchema in src/lib/forms.ts now return keys such as form.errors.messageTooShort, which ContactForm/NewsletterForm translate. If you show schema errors yourself, translate them with useTranslations(locale)(message).

migrations.title: Component registry fixes
migrations.description: React (.tsx) component files, ConsentBanner and GoogleMap were missing from component-registry.json, and several components did not declare their Icon dependency, so partial component installs deleted files that were still imported. If you scaffolded with a subset of components, check that ConsentBanner and any .tsx components you use exist; re-add them from the v2.0.0 template if not.
